items.headline: New Portal Launches for UAE Golden Visa Rules and Costs

bullets: On Friday 16 October, Dubai Land Department recorded 363 sales worth AED 1.1bn, which is 23.1% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 55.1% of Friday sales, compared to a 7-day average of 66.7%.
The median price was AED 1,753 per square foot, up 6.3% over the last 30 days and down 0.1% from last year.
In September new rental contracts, JVC 1-bedroom apartments had a median rent of AED 69,000 a year, rising 3.2% on the month.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas for sales were Dubai South (DWC) with 289 sales, JVC with 208 sales, and Downtown Jebel Ali with 136 sales.
talking_points: A new portal has launched for UAE Golden Visa rules and costs, directly impacting residency rules and investor eligibility.
Meraki Developers has entered Dubai South with seven projects, highlighting new developer activity and expanding residential supply.
Missoni has partnered for branded residences on Dubai Islands, showcasing luxury branded project launches in a key waterfront area.

items.impact_reason: Boosts inventory and offers new investment options.

items.headline: Etihad Rail connects Dubai and Fujairah in 70 minutes
items.summary: Train travel between Dubai and Fujairah takes 70 minutes with fares starting at AED 29. Currently, only one daily service runs on this route.
items.why: Improves inter-emirate connectivity and regional accessibility.

items.impact_reason: Corporate acquisition with minimal direct impact on buyers.
